en: A multiview color postcard showing several town scenes: apartment blocks and flower beds, a forest lodge with the word "CABANA" on its facade, historic civic buildings, panoramic views of the town center and main square with gardens and streets. A bold yellow title on the front reads "GHEORGHENI". The reverse side has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian stamp marked "POSTA ROMANA 2 LEI", and postmarks dated 1982.
